builder.objective: REPAIR V3-05: Execute the completion as a single atomic operation: add a repository-level transaction (e.g. SQLite withTransactionAsync wrapping the todo update + contribution insert, with an in-memory equivalent) or a completion use-case in the domain/application layer that writes both the todo status and the ContributionEntry in one transaction, and have the UI call that single operation. Add tests that verify failure atomicity: (a) when the todo update fails, no ContributionEntry is created; (b) when the contribution creation fails, the todo is not marked completed; (c) a retry after any failure cannot produce a second ContributionEntry.
